import { View, div, svg, image } from "gpui-kit";
import { h_flex, ScrollHandle } from "gpui-base";
import { spaces, panes, run, theme } from "herdr";

export default class Tabs extends View {
  init() {
    this.pressed = null;
  }

  render() {
    const t = theme();
    const space = spaces().find(p => p.active);
    const item = (c) => {
      const lead = panes().find(p => p.tab === c.id && p.program?.agent) ?? panes().find(p => p.tab === c.id);
      const program = lead?.program;
      return h_flex().when(Boolean(program?.icon), el => el.child(program.tint ? svg(program.icon).size(14).text_color(t.muted) : image(program.icon).size(14)));
    };
    return h_flex().children((space?.tabs ?? []).map(item));
  }
}
